chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Eat on the day of al-Fitr before you go out to the place of prayer."

key_terms.اَلْمُصَلَّى: The place of prayer, specifically the open area where Eid prayers are performed
key_terms.يَوْمَ اَلْفِطْرِ: The day of Eid al-Fitr (Festival of Breaking the Fast)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice regarding eating before Eid al-Fitr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* codifies the Sunnah of eating an odd number of dates before departing for Eid al-Fitr prayer, a practice rooted in the Prophet’s tradition to signify the conclusion of Ramadan fasting. Scholarly consensus emphasizes this act as a distinct marker of Eid al-Fitr, differentiating it from Eid al-Adha where eating occurs after prayer, thereby reinforcing the ritualistic joy and gratitude of the believer.
